rejection_summary: Witchville (2010): rejected during research; low-budget presentation evidence and insufficient support for a complete DNA vector strong enough to justify deterministic acceptance.

Tales of an Ancient Empire (2010): rejected during research; sword-and-sorcery premise but insufficient evidence of the live profile's required worldbuilding, magic-system depth and presentation quality.
Fading of the Cries (2008): rejected during research; strong undead/necromancy elements but narrow worldbuilding and insufficient evidence for a complete qualifying DNA vector.
Dark World (2010): rejected during research; substantive review evidence explicitly describes cheap CGI/dilettantish presentation, strongly conflicting with the profile's visual-quality preference.
Journey to Promethea (2010): rejected during research; epic-fantasy premise but insufficient substantive evidence for a complete qualifying DNA vector without inventing unknown dimensions.
